task.description: Get Hazel to return something of Vic's at the Hazel's Bakery, giving them a reason to talk.
task.goal_state: Hazel and Vic are both present at Hazel's Bakery with a positive reaction flag set on Vic

lines: (Hazel looks like: Hazel: a baker with a look reflecting sedentary, candid, excitable, astute -- palette and silhouette chosen to read at a glance..)
(They are close friends with Vic -- Hazel and Vic: close friends -- splitting a bakery order every week.)
GOOSE: (honks meaningfully near the Hazel's Bakery)
Hazel: (follows up on what the goose left behind: can't help laughing and joins in with a honk of their own)
Vic: (is drawn over by it -- the laughter draws a second resident over to see what's so funny)
Hazel: (startled, then softening, remembering Hazel and Vic: close friends -- splitting a bakery order every week.) "Oh -- it's you."
(Task resolves: Get Hazel to return something of Vic's at the Hazel's Bakery, giving them a reason to talk.)
